descriptor.name: Orlando Orange County assessment parcel polygons
descriptor.scope: Orange County assessment parcel polygons; bounded technical review around the unchanged Alafaya city locator. Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and currentness are unverified.

evidence: Frozen packet and review identify the OCPA Orange County assessment parcel provider at https://vgispublic.ocpafl.org/server/rest/services/Webmap/PARCEL/MapServer/4, with PARCEL string IDs and polygon samples.

First-party parcel metadata (https://ocpaimages.ocpafl.org/api/Content/GetContentDynamicFile?contentFileID=405230), page 1, identifies tax parcel polygons and property-assessment cadastral purpose; safe excerpts and county extent retained in evidence/source-purpose.json.

The unchanged Alafaya locator falls inside the official county metadata and live layer extents. The frozen two-ID public probe supplies local polygons; the qualifier tests fresh exact IDs and local area membership.
